source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: How should a skill's relevance be judged when a request uses different wording from its description?

options.text: Require the description's exact words before selecting the skill
options.feedback: Different wording can express the same task. The notes describe relevance-based activation rather than a mandatory magic word.

options.text: Choose the skill used most recently for any document task
options.feedback: Recent use does not establish a match to the current request. The procedure's intended outcome and conditions matter.

options.text: Compare the requested work with the skill's intended purpose
options.feedback: A semantic match can make a skill relevant even when the request uses different words from the description.

options.text: Prefer the broadest skill because it mentions more task types
options.feedback: A broad description can obscure task boundaries. Mentioning more categories does not establish the best fit for this request.
